name: FoundrList

sources.title: Pricing — Free listing $0; 7-day featured $29; 14-day featured $39; feed ad $49/wk; sidebar ad $79/wk; directory submission service $179–$279
Submit — JS app; 'Requirements' page for launch materials
Homepage — 'the next social network for founders and builders'

conditions: Free tier gives a public listing discoverable in search/categories with community votes and comments — but no featured placement, no verified badges, and no guaranteed dofollow backlink
Verified product + user badges come with paid featured plans ($29/7d, $39/14d) — free listings appear to need 'badge verification' the paid tiers waive
Account creation is required (Get started / Profile / Analytics flows)
requirements: A startup/product to launch; community voting and comments drive visibility
Account required; the submit flow is a JS app at /submit (option=standard in the 'Launch' nav link)
Paid tiers add: instant publish, verified badges, top-of-home placement, guaranteed DR73+ dofollow backlink
preparation: Product name, tagline, URL, logo, description, category
Decide free listing vs $29 (7-day featured) vs $39 (14-day featured)
Optional: $49/wk home feed ad (~80k impressions) or $79/wk sidebar ad (~200k impressions)
workflow: Sign up / get started at foundrlist.com
Complete the 'Requirements' step — product details and media
Free: listing goes live in search/categories; paid: instant publish + verified badges + homepage featuring
Track performance from the built-in /analytics page
watchFor: Free listing lacks the verified badges and guaranteed dofollow backlink — the paid plans explicitly bundle them
Every plan card is labelled 'Most Picked' — the badges are marketing decoration, not a real signal
Directory submission service ($179/50 dirs, $279/100 dirs) is a separate upsell from the listing itself
The submit page is a JS app — field details beyond 'Requirements' aren't publicly rendered
Platform positions itself as a social network (feed, chat, analytics) — engagement affects visibility
countsAsLive: Product has a public profile page on foundrlist.com discoverable via /search and categories, with votes/comments enabled
unknowns: Whether the free tier needs any badge/backlink verification to publish
Exact submission form fields behind the JS app
